mission: YouTube resource discovery, verification and curation for the LearnPath curriculum

method: YouTube Data API was unavailable in the research environment (no API key; the desktop watch page and InnerTube player endpoint return a bot check for datacenter IPs), so status.embeddable could not be read directly.

Embeddability was therefore established from YouTube's own oEmbed provider together with the official embed endpoints: oEmbed HTTP 200 + iframe html AND /embed/{id} HTTP 200 AND youtube-nocookie.com/embed/{id} HTTP 200 => embed_status verified.
oEmbed HTTP 401 means the owner disabled embedding for that video; HTTP 404 means the video is not available to oEmbed. Those are recorded as failed and excluded.
Every non-200 oEmbed response was re-checked at least three times across the session before being treated as a failure, because transient failures occur.

Metadata (title, channel, duration, publish date, view count) was read from first-party public pages: the m.youtube.com description header (exact publish date), the search results structured data (exact duration) and the oEmbed response (canonical title).
Nothing was downloaded, mirrored, proxied or re-hosted; only public metadata was read.

learnpath_mapping.note: This file is a research dataset. Each resource carries a learnpath_type, learnpath_labels and editorNote-ready text so it can be converted into src/lib/content/resources.ts entries without guessing. See learnpath-resources.import.json for the exact import shape.

editorial_score_formula.teaching_quality: 0-20 from the curator rubric (explanation quality, structure, accuracy of teaching)
editorial_score_formula.technical_correctness: 0-20 from the curator rubric (current APIs, correct concepts, no known errors)
editorial_score_formula.completeness: 0-20 from the curator rubric (coverage of the skill's scope)
editorial_score_formula.practical_value: 0-15 from the curator rubric (built artefacts, exercises, projects)
editorial_score_formula.freshness: 0-10 = 10 * 0.5^(age_months / half_life); half_life 12 months for fast-moving topics, 36 for medium, 84 for stable ones
editorial_score_formula.clarity: 0-5 from the curator rubric (pace, production, accessibility of explanation)
editorial_score_formula.community_signal: 0-10 = 10 * min(1, log10(views+1)/7.5), +5% if the channel carries YouTube's verified badge; recorded at last_checked_at
editorial_score_formula.note: The rubric dimensions are LearnPath editorial judgement, stated in why_recommended; the freshness and community terms are computed from verified public data. It is not a YouTube rating.

required_coverage.note: How each category the brief required us to investigate is represented. Nineteen dedicated categories are shipped; the brief's 'Full Stack' theme is deliberately not a separate category because LearnPath models full-stack work as a skill that spans the web, JavaScript/TypeScript, frontend, backend and deployment categories, and its roadmaps already compose them that way.
